## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

The *Nāvaṅgapañha* ("The Ship", Mil 7.3.5) is a question-and-answer text in the seventh book of the *Milindapañha* [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records three modern translations in three languages and notes a thematic or textual association with the *Vitakkasutta* of the *Sacca Saṁyutta* (SN 56.7) [SuttaCentral].
According to machine text-reuse computations by DharmaNexus, the *Nāvaṅgapañha* shares 311 matching passages across 51 Pali works, while exhibiting no cross-language matches of significant score [DharmaNexus]. Its largest external textual correspondences in the canonical literature appear in the *Sacca Saṁyutta* (SN 56, particularly segment §4.1 matching §22.2 in SN 56) and the *Tikanipāta* of the *Aṅguttara Nikāya* (AN 3) [DharmaNexus]. Within the *Milindapañha* itself, the text shares standard formulaic phrases and similes with numerous other *aṅgapañha* discourses, most prominently the *Vāyuṅgapañha* (Mil 7.4.4), *Sūriyaṅgapañha* (Mil 7.4.8), *Pathavīaṅgapañha* (Mil 7.4.1), and *Ākāsaṅgapañha* (Mil 7.4.6) [DharmaNexus].
*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
